title: I WANNA GO SHORT MOVIE
description: This film was created with a purpose to open a door to a better future for Abel and his team. 1. Supporting the Launch Donations will help cover the essential costs of organizing the film’s inauguration events in two cities. These events are more than celebrations — they are opportunities to share the story, raise awareness, and give these young creators the recognition they deserve. 2. Building a Sustainable Future The true goal of this project goes beyond a single film. We want to help Abel and his team build a future where they can stand on their own through their talent and creativity. Funds raised will be invested in long-term tools such as professional filmmaking equipment and production resources. These are not temporary solutions — they are investments that will allow these talented young orphans to continue creating films, telling stories, and generating income independently for years to come. This is not just about supporting a movie. It is about giving a group of determined young creators the chance to build a lasting future through their passion.

This Wednesday, she translates her musical landscapes into a stripped back, live set. synths-laptop-vocals. Space is intentionally limited.

description: This Saturday at KDMC, the focus is African electronic dance music on its own terms. For years, sounds from this continent have traveled the world, shaped global dance culture, and been reintroduced back to us under different names. This night is about recognizing where those ideas come from and celebrating them without translation or compromise. Benaiah, Drømmer, and Ben Arsenal three DJs from three continents, all meeting around African-rooted electronic

title: Amapiano Worldwide
description: Amapiano Worldwide lands in Addis Ababa at Kuriftu African Village. A luxury resort experience blending music, culture & vibes. Jan 4, 2026. AMAPIANO WORLDWIDE — ADDIS ABABA 🇪🇹 On January 4th, 2026, Amapiano Worldwide lands in Addis Ababa for a special resort edition at the iconic Kuriftu African Village. Set inside one of Ethiopia’s most beautiful luxury resorts, this experience blends Amapiano, Afro sounds, culture, and elevated leisure. Expect open-air energy, curated DJs, warm Ethiopian hospitality, and a crowd that moves with intention. This is not just a party — it’s a destination moment.

title: YeFikir Esat w/ Tensae: ፍቅርን ፈራን
description: ❤️ ✨️ This round of YeFikirEsat, we’re joined by Tensae, a lover of Ethiopian literature and the mind behind @InjeraChronicles, for an episode that’s about to change the way you think about love: "ፍቅርን ፈራን" Using Laureate Tsegaye Gabre-Medhins work as a point of departure, Tensae revisits Ethiopian cultural narratives to explore how love has been imagined and used as a tool for political expression through movies, music, and theatre. It’s charged, metaphorical, and deeply Addis.
